decisions.reason: This is temporary construction-site setup. The contractor brings and sets up its facilities and equipment; no new product is purchased.
This is temporary traffic management, including setup and removal. The materials remain the contractor's property.
This is trench excavation, formation of the trench bottom, and backfilling. No new pipe, bedding, or fill is ordered by this position.
The work reuses gravel excavated and stockpiled beside the trench; no new gravel is supplied.
The position covers placing, grading, and compacting soil already processed under the preceding position, not supplying new soil.
The position covers collection, transport, and landfill disposal of existing excavated soil, including placement at the landfill.
The contractor provides materials for temporary trench crossings that it must dismantle. No new crossing or crossing materials are purchased.
The quantity is for pump operating hours for dewatering, not the purchase of a pump.
The text covers daily dewatering and a temporary pump sump. The sump pipe is provided for use, then extracted and hauled away.
The existing delineator posts are removed, stored, and reinstalled. No new posts are supplied.
The existing traffic signs and posts are removed, stored, and reinstalled at their original locations.
The ordered quantity is for dump-truck hours. The pipe supply wording appears in subsequent section headings, not in the truck position.
The work consists of collecting, loading, and returning packaging and protective caps from pipes already delivered.
This is a surcharge for tying the new pipeline into the existing network, not for supplying the pipe. Required fittings are paid for separately.
The position orders core drilling in an existing structure. Protective coating touch-ups are incidental to the work, and no conduits or cables are supplied.
The work transports and reuses previously excavated soil as backfill. No new fill is supplied.
The position covers transport and landfill disposal of existing excavated soil, not the supply of new material.
This is temporary excavation shoring. The rate covers use, wear, installation, and removal of the sheet piles, not their purchase.
